nc714d17821.headline: Clothing Division: Customs Dollar Behind Decline in Holiday Imports
nc714d17821.summary: Suppliers report a decline in clothing, textiles, and shoe imports in Sudan caused by customs dollar rise, exchange rate volatility, poor port performance, and fee burdens.
nc714d17821.why: Import declines affect Sudan's retail and manufacturing sectors, reflecting broader economic challenges including currency instability and logistics bottlenecks.
